about: The edc: URI scheme (mappingLayers ML1-a, ruled by BRONZE_CROWN 2026-10-24; respelled in ML3.1 Part A, ruled by AMBER_JOURNEY 2026-10-26: Q41-Q43, Q51). Kinds are DATA: edcUri.js mints and parses only the kinds listed here, and an unlisted kind is refused by name. A template is '/'-separated segments after baseIri; a segment is literal text and {placeholders}. Every placeholder value is encoded by segmentEncoding unless the kind lists it under verbatimPartList (a part copied from an already-minted URI, whose spelling another module owns). The ONE path-valued part (pathValuedPartName) keeps '/' literal: it is encoded piece by piece and joined with '/', must END its template (only an elementPathSuffixTemplateList entry may follow it) and must begin with a CURIE prefix (elementPathFirstPiecePattern, RULING BR2). Every whole-segment literal of every template is a RESERVED WORD that no single-segment placeholder may take as its value; that is what makes the templates disjoint without a lookup. A published URI is never respelled; a scheme change is a new prefix segment (D-URI). Nothing here is published yet (w3id ruled NO public registration; a local stub resolves).

segmentEncoding.about: UTF-8 after NFC; each byte whose ASCII character is in literalCharacterList is kept, every other byte becomes %XX with uppercase hex. '/', '@', '%', space and ',' are therefore always encoded inside a single-segment value; inside the path-valued part '/' separates pieces and every piece is encoded this way (an empty, '.' or '..' piece is refused by forbiddenSegmentTextList).

partPatternByPartName.about: a part listed here must match its pattern at mint and at parse (Q43, Q51: a content hash is 64 lowercase hex, so a label can never pass for one)

vocabularyIriByCurie.about: objects that are vocabulary terms, not graph nodes: an abstention row's object (SSSOM 1.0: sssom:NoTermFound MAY stand as object_id)

kindList.about: a HubReference card (exists; minted by the hub framework as namespace + release segment + '/' + addressSignature)
a standard's slot; standardName is the _source name the graph stamps on every node and edge; elementStableId keeps its '/' (Q42)
a mapping layer, floating: resolves to its current Standard version
a layer version by its tag (an alias the registry records; never reassigned)
a layer version by its content id
one mapping assertion, scoped by the decision block that holds it (R-1)
a schema block a published manifest lists, by its content id; answers its frozen text, or for a licence-held standard its metadata and the reason the text is withheld (Q51)
a decision schema block a published layer version lists, by its hash; text or withheld metadata as schemaBlock (Q51)
element x layer version
element x layer, follows the layer
a published manifest by its label (an alias)
a manifest by its membership hash
manifest x element, answered from the manifest's own relationship schema blocks for every hub (Q41: the version is in the URI; ruling (b) AMBER_JOURNEY 2026-10-26)
manifest x hub x element; the reserved literal 'hub' puts the hub AHEAD of the standard, so the element path ends the URI (Q42)
manifest (by membership hash) x element (Q43)
manifest (by membership hash) x hub x element (Q43)
a person, by educore user refId, never the username (D-AUTHOR)
a machine author, by its judge identity
an organisation
(ML3-b) the whole site's SSSOM mapping registry: it imports every layer's registry (each layer's registry id is its floating layer URI, layer/{layerKey})

(ML3-a) a mapping predicate EDUcore declares, spelled as the r1 rater sets already expand it (edc:bestMatch = https://w3id.org/EDUcore/bestMatch; registered, so never respelled). CLOSED: only a term listed here and defined in vocabularyTermDefinitionByName is minted or parsed. D-RATERPRED.

vocabularyTermDefinitionByName.about: (ML3-a) what each vocabularyTerm means; the stub resolver returns this text. Raters were never asked a SKOS relation, so neither term claims one; agreement is measured on the object (D-RATERPRED).
vocabularyTermDefinitionByName.bestMatch: The author chose this meaning (HubReference card) as the best answer for the subject element among the cards offered. No SKOS relation (exact, close, broad, narrow) is asserted.
vocabularyTermDefinitionByName.alsoAcceptable: The author marked this meaning as also acceptable (the rater tool's Same) for the subject element, beside a best answer. No SKOS relation is asserted.
